Governance & Compliance

Financial Governance & Audit Policy

Annual financial reporting, non-profit auditing procedures, and transparent accounting rules for academic grant funds.

Effective Date: 2025-01-01
Next Review: 2026-01-01
PUBLISHED

Financial Governance & Audit Policy

UKABCS is registered in the UK as a non-profit academic society. Financial records, grant expenditures, and partner contributions undergo annual accounting audits.

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
